title: SongSketch AnyKey
user: A young or returning browser-based songwriter who wants to sketch an any-length melody and drums without being locked to a scale or installing a DAW.
smallest_useful_product: PWA with drum grid, free-pitch piano roll, one editable pitch curve, loop/export MIDI and a self-contained HTML share file.
constraints: All audio stays local. No copyrighted samples; synthesize original drum sounds with Web Audio.
